name: week
title: The partner program this week
subtitle: Decisions owed, clashes, tiers that moved, and money waiting on someone

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind, partner, item, detail from (select 'decide' as kind,partner,reference as item,promise||', waiting '||days_waiting||' days' as detail from registrations_to_decide union all select 'protection',partner,reference,case when days_left<0 then 'Lapsed '||(-days_left)||' days ago' else 'Ends in '||days_left||' days' end from registrations_expiring where days_left<=14 union all select 'mdf',partner,reference,finding from mdf_queue union all select 'onboarding',partner,step,'Overdue '||days_overdue||' days' from onboarding_stuck union all select 'agreement',partner,state,issue from partner_watch union all select 'rule',partner,record,rule from compliance_gaps) x order by kind, partner

sections.title: Registrations that clash
sections.note: Two partners on one customer, or a partner on a direct account. Decide before approving.
sections.sql: select reference, partner, end_customer, clashes_with, other_party, matched_on from registration_conflicts order by end_customer

sections.title: Tier review
sections.note: Revenue is the last 12 months. Certified means at least one current certification.
sections.sql: select partner, current_tier, revenue_12m, certified_now, status, detail from tier_status where status<>'On tier' order by partner

sections.title: MDF waiting on someone
sections.sql: select reference, partner, activity, state, amount, finding from mdf_queue order by days desc

name: program
title: Partner program health
subtitle: Revenue, tiers, win rates and what market development funds returned

sections.title: Revenue by partner, last 12 months
sections.sql: select partner, currency, revenue_12m, registered_12m, round(100*registered_12m/nullif(revenue_12m,0),0) as pct_registered, last_sale from partner_revenue where state<>'exited' order by revenue_12m desc

sections.title: Every active partner against its tier
sections.sql: select partner, current_tier, earns, status, next_tier, revenue_to_next, certified_to_next from tier_status order by partner

sections.title: Market development funds
sections.sql: select partner, currency, allocated, committed, paid, available, pct_paid, days_left from mdf_position order by partner

sections.title: Partners gone quiet
sections.sql: select partner, kind, owner, last_registration, last_sale from quiet_partners order by partner
